text:
maria-ops: Heads up — vendor A just reconfirmed lead times. They say standard H100 top-off ETA is 4 weeks but they have a partial air-lift slot next week for 30 units if we accept refurbished/recertified and a small expedite fee.
alejandro-vendorA: Correct, we can move 30 units next week as a partial fulfillment. Refurbs are OEM-certified, same firmware, tracked separately. Expedited freight + customs handling adds $250/unit.
jessica-logistics: If we take the 30, where does it land? FRA or IAD? We need depot allocation and HS codes for customs. Also need serials for inbound RMA staging.
maria-ops: Preference is FRA for EU clusters (we have two EU DCs hitting capacity). IAD only if FRA quota hits customs delay. Can we get an AWB and provisional manifest?
alejandro-vendorA: Tentative FRA landing. AWB and manifest ready after PO amendment. I can push serial range now: REF-BATCH-5678 (30 units) — these will be shipped with temp loaner tags and separate RMA paperwork for any DOA.
ravi-procurement: Pricing question — confirm base unit price for new vs refurbished, and what credit we get on DOA returns. Also need SLA on replacements: do we get loaners while replacements are processed?
alejandro-vendorA: New unit price unchanged. Refurb price is -10%. DOA credit = full refund within 14 days + prepaid RMA. Loaners: we can provide 10 loaner H100 equivalents for the duration but they are tagged as temporary and billed at a daily rate of $15/day, capped at 14 days.
nate-supply: Our immediate shortfall is ~60 GPUs across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. If we accept 30 refurbables + 10 loaners we still short 20. Can we split remaining 20 into a sea shipment arriving in ~3 weeks?
alejandro-vendorA: Yes, we can queue the next 20 on sea (slower, cheaper) — sea ETA ~21 days. Would you like us to combine invoice or keep separate nodes (air vs sea)?
maria-ops: Keep invoices separate. Need separate tracking for warranty/RMA between air-refurb and sea-new. Also, we need customs HS code and broker details.
jessica-logistics: HS code: 8471.70.90 (computer parts, verify with customs). Broker: Redwood customs partner (FreightHaus EU). I'll add them to the manifest. Alejandro, please include broker contact.
alejandro-vendorA: Will do. Adding FreightHaus EU contact + provisional AWB: AWB: EU123-890-REF. Sea booking: BL: SEA-456-2026.
shipping-bot: AWB created: EU123-890-REF | ETA FRA: 2026-04-12 | Carrier: AeroFast | Pieces: 30 | Weight: 900kg
ravi-procurement: Can legal sign off on loaner terms? cc @legal. Also need expedited fee approval: $250/unit on 30 units = $7.5k.
maria-ops: Approving expedite fee for the air batch to prevent a capacity outage, provided we get full DOA protection and prepaid RMA labels.
jessica-logistics: For the RMA flow: incoming REF batch -> quick test at FRA depot -> any DOA flagged -> vendor pays shipping back + refund. We'll use temporary pool SKUs to avoid inventory mix-ups. 
nate-supply: Action items: 1) maria to amend PO to accept 30 refurb + 20 sea. 2) alejandro to send manifest + serials + broker contact. 3) jessica to prep FRA depot for intake and RMA lane. 4) ravi to confirm payment for expedite and loaner billing terms. 5) shipping-bot to post final AWB once booked.
maria-ops: I'll amend PO today and loop legal. Thanks all. :+1:
alejandro-vendorA: Sending manifest and serial CSV by EOD. Will flag refurbished units in the manifest with REF tag.
shipping-bot: AWB updated: EU123-890-REF | Status: BOOKED | Pickup window: 24h | ETA FRA: 2026-04-12
